name: Savings sweep
description: Sends BSV from this agent account to one savings address you choose, a few dollars at a time, so spending money does not pile up in an agent account. At most $5 a send, $20 a day, $200 in total. You must replace the placeholder in sendTo with your own savings address or paymail before loading. Sending is final.
goals: When this account holds more than it needs for its other work, send $5 of BSV to the savings address. Never send anywhere else. Leave at least $2 for network fees.

spec.trades: BSV only, sent to one address you set
spec.needs: Your savings address in sendTo before loading
